text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking a break at the park when I see
a bunch
of kids chasing an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh ho ho ho! You won't catch me in a
million
years!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Dang it! Give us another chance! We'll
get you
this time!

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, we'll corner you this time for sure!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
As a princess, I welcome any challenge!
Let's see
what you've got!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Wait uuuuup!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen such a one-sided game of
tag.
Kawakami Princes is no easy target.
She leaps
over a swing and scales the
jungle gym with ease.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Hehe! None of you are a match for me!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
That's no fair! You're older so you hafta
go easy
on us!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A princess never pulls her punches! If
you're mad
that you can't win, then you
need to think harder
and figure out how
to beat me!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
There's no problem that can't be solved
as long as
you have wisdom, courage,
and an iron fist!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You over there! You agree with me,
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you. You're a master instructor of
running,
so give some advice to these
children!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Well, there's no way they stand a chance
of
winning a footrace against an
Umamusume, so to
even the odds...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If Kawakami Princess has to catch all of
the
children on her own, it should be a
challenge even
for her.
choice_data_list: もっとハンデをつけてあげたら？
choice_data_list_en: Why not give them a bigger handicap?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't sit well with me for a princess
such as
myself to be called an "it," but...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A princess's worth boils down to how
well she can
nab a prince!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I shall accept this challenge!
I'll have
you all rounded up in no time!
I'll start counting,
so get ready. One,
two, three...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the count of ten, Kawakami Princess
begins
chasing down the children with
alarming ferocity
and catches them one
after another!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suggest adding a rule where the
children can
step on her shadow to tag
her, so they don't
necessarily need to
physically catch up with her.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My, giving them the privilege to touch a

princess's shadow since they cannot
quite reach
me is an excellent
compromise!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely wonderful. This reminds me
of stories
where the noble knight forever
chases after a
princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Now, then! Try your hardest to catch me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess dashes off with a
flourish. She
brilliantly uses the shade of
the trees to evade her
own shadow
being touched.
